continuation_context.what_was_done: Replaced the fChainPred-based VBracketFormula with a 3-disjunct IH-based construction. Forward direction fully proved for all disjuncts. Backward direction proved for 3 out of 4 sub-cases.
continuation_context.what_remains: beta_0(r0) sub-case backward, and neg_partialBracketExist_is_vbracket n+1 backward
continuation_context.key_insight: The BracketFormula-level proof cannot handle the sub-case where beta_0(r0) holds because the V-bracket (existential structure) cannot universally block all potential first witnesses x0 > r0. The paper uses VecEA2 endpoint conditions that provide a recursive decomposition: restricting to (r0, z1) changes the endpoint condition from top to alpha_0, giving a decreasing measure for induction.
